_what: Identifiers that once existed in this tree, are gone now, and whose removing commit never said so. Recorded here so the gate reports only what is NEW. Recording is cheap; the point is that a loss stops being SILENT.
_how_to_read: An entry is not an excuse. Each one is either a deliberate refactor or an OPEN regression with a task. The second kind must name its task. When an open regression is FIXED, its entries are removed rather than left here, or the baseline becomes a lie.
_closed_2026-08-07: The wallet-picker cluster was an OPEN REGRESSION here for one day and is now RESTORED, so walletsCache / loadWallets / renderWallets / disableWallets no longer appear as accepted. The capability is back under new names (enumerateWallets, renderWalletPicker, payWith, iconOK, b58), and the four old names stay absent by design rather than by accident: the new version drops the library, defers the list to a click, and returns the wallets rather than caching them in a module global.

accepted.walletsCache: SUPERSEDED, not lost. The restored picker returns the wallet list from enumerateWallets() rather than holding it in a module global, so nothing needs the cache. Removing it also removed a declared-but-unused binding, which is exactly the kind of dead name this gate should not have to track.
accepted.loadWallets: SUPERSEDED by enumerateWallets. The original was async because it imported @wallet-standard/app from esm.sh; the restored one is synchronous because the Wallet Standard handshake is a window event and needs no library.
accepted.renderWallets: SUPERSEDED by renderWalletPicker, which renders on CLICK and in place of the pay button rather than on load. The original rendered on load, which pushed the QR below the fold and needed a two-pane layout to undo.
accepted.disableWallets: SUPERSEDED. The original disabled every wallet button during payment; the restored one removes the picker outright when a wallet is chosen, so there is nothing left to disable.
accepted.applyI18n: DELIBERATE. Renamed rather than lost; the page still localises, verified live with ?lang=pt rendering Portuguese.
accepted.pollConfirm: DELIBERATE. Superseded by awaitConfirmation when confirmTransaction became a getSignatureStatuses poll, because the chosen RPC endpoint answers a browser Origin and the old one 403s it.
accepted.isUsdc: DELIBERATE. Replaced by the KNOWN_MINTS allowlist in a738de6, whose subject says so: naming the asset from an allowlist rather than from the mint.
accepted.READ_RPC: DELIBERATE. The read/settle RPC constants collapsed to one in 41d0fc3, because the split rested on a premise that was refuted and two constants holding one value drift apart.
accepted.tracked_files: DELIBERATE. Local variable removed in 7b3a697 when the last two hardcoded gate scopes were derived from git instead.
